title: refactor(core)!: retire RegisteredAction and deepFreeze from the @object-ui/core entry

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XH4WSrD2AHNZsG3WQ5eREZa)_

Part of #25921

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none (neither name appears under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**`)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`@object-ui/core` 的根入口不再导出 `RegisteredAction` 和 `deepFreeze` 两个名字;这是 #25921 的第 15 批。两者仍留在各自模块里,包内代码照常使用。
- 为什么改:两个仓库里没有任何代码从包入口引用它们;包外仅有的同名文字都是别处自己声明的同名接口或函数(一个 dogfood 测试的接口、四个测试里的本地 `deepFreeze` 函数和沙箱源码文本)。
- 风险与回滚:只把两行 `export *` 改成具名列表,无声明删除、无模块移动;外部 npm 宿主若从入口 import 这两个名字会编译失败(未实测,changeset 写了 BREAKING 与替代写法)。`!` patch,回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/core/src/index.ts`(freeze-schema 具名列表)、`ui/packages/core/src/actions/index.ts`(ActionEngine 具名列表)、`.changeset/25921-core-homonym-only-exports.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`,预期两个名字都 `verified … (export, ui/packages/core/src/…)`、退出 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Batch 15 as named in the seat's amendment 6716057610 on claim 6716004841 (census `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/ui/25921-b15-census.md`, `origin/main` `604a2b3b`, hotcrm `6961ab1`). After this batch the `@object-ui/core` entry holds no other name retirable under the card's rules.

- **`ui/packages/core/src/actions/index.ts`** (unpublished sub-barrel that `src/index.ts` star-exports): `export * from './ActionEngine.js'` becomes a named list (`ActionEngine`, `ACTION_LOCATIONS`, `ActionLocation`, `ShortcutBinding`) without `RegisteredAction`, which stays in the module as the type of `ActionEngine`'s private registry.
- **`ui/packages/core/src/index.ts`**: `export * from './utils/freeze-schema.js'` becomes a named list of the module's other seven exports (`SYSTEM_VIEW_MARKER`, `defineSystemView`, `isSystemView`, `cloneAsOverride`, `DeepReadonly`, `DeepMutable`, `SystemView`) without `deepFreeze`, which stays in the module for `defineSystemView`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/25921-core-homonym-only-exports.md`: `!` patch, BREAKING, FROM/TO for each name, `runtime-export-retired` ×2 (FROM spans 1:1), both declaration lines.

No declaration is deleted and no module moves.

## Tests

- Census (`rg -o -w -F` over both trees, then each outside hit read by hand): `RegisteredAction`'s only outside hit is `packages/qa/dogfood/test/organization-rename-door.dogfood.test.ts`, which declares its own `interface RegisteredAction`. `deepFreeze`'s outside hits are four local `function deepFreeze` declarations (in `packages/spec`, `plugin-security` and two `service-analytics` tests) and `var deepFreeze` inside the sandbox source text of `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`. None imports `@object-ui/core`. hotcrm: 0 for both. Positive controls, `git grep -l -w -F NAME origin/main -- . ':!ui/packages/core'` (files): `ActionEngine` 65, `defineSystemView` 5.
- Rule 3: the emitted-declaration walk from every kept export reaches neither name (a private member's type does not reach the `.d.ts`). Neither is in the core README, which teaches `defineSystemView`, `cloneAsOverride` and `isSystemView` (all kept). Core's only JS export is `.`.
- Reverse probe of the entry (TypeScript checker export list of `src/index.ts`): 476 names before, 474 after; exactly `RegisteredAction` and `deepFreeze` gone, none added. Built `dist/index.js` imported at runtime: `deepFreeze` is not a key; `defineSystemView`, `isSystemView`, `cloneAsOverride`, `SYSTEM_VIEW_MARKER`, `ActionEngine` and `ACTION_LOCATIONS` are.
- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/core...' build && pnpm --filter @object-ui/core run type-check` under the lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/core/` → Test Files 233 passed (233), Tests 4376 passed | 27 skipped (4403).
- No test was added or removed, and there is no ablation: this only stops re-exporting two names and changes no tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- Three more names the batch 14 census counted as homonym-only stay on the card, because each outside hit is prose about core's own function, and prose counts as a consumer: `hasConflictingColumnIdentity` (a JSDoc in a `plugin-detail` test), `evaluatePlainCondition` (the v18 18.3 release note) and `meetsContrastLevel` (a 2026-06 audit under a `core/theme/ThemeEngine.ts` heading).
- After this batch the seat records `@object-ui/core` as exhausted under the card's current rules (amendment 6716057610).
